content: ESA - BepiColombo reveals Mercury in a new light Science & Exploration BepiColombo reveals Mercury in a new light 09/12/2024 12279 views 109 likes ESA / Science & Exploration / Space Science / BepiColombo On 1 December 2024, BepiColombo flew past Mercury for the fifth time . During this flyby, BepiColombo became the first spacecraft ever to observe Mercury in mid-infrared light. The new images reveal variations in temperature and composition across the planet's cratered surface. Mercury during BepiColombo’s fifth flyby Mercury is by far the least-explored rocky planet in the Solar System. BepiColombo is the third mission to ever visit the planet, and in 2026 it will be the second mission to enter orbit around Mercury.
